settings.chat_enabled.description: Continue or safely fork OMP sessions, or start full sessions in any supported installed harness from the Agentik panel and optional desktop widget.
settings.chat_enabled.label: Enable coding session chat
settings.reduce_motion.label: Reduce motion
settings.reduce_motion.description: Use static orb frames and reveal live assistant text immediately.
settings.high_contrast.label: Increase contrast
settings.high_contrast.description: Use stronger session backgrounds and primary text contrast.
settings.display_label.description: What to show as the primary label for each session in the panel: the project directory, the agent-chosen session name, or the active model (name only, without the provider).
settings.display_label.label: Primary label
settings.filter_attention.description: Show only sessions that are waiting or blocked.
settings.excluded_projects.description: Comma-separated project directory names or full paths to omit from Agentik monitoring and chat.
settings.excluded_projects.label: Excluded projects
settings.filter_attention.label: Needs attention only
settings.sort_mode.description: Order panel sessions by running time or attention-first (blocked, then waiting).
settings.sort_mode.label: Sort order
settings.notification_cooldown_seconds.d: Minimum time between Agentik attention notifications.
settings.notification_privacy.descriptio: Keep notification bodies free of project and task names; show only the attention state.
settings.notification_privacy.label: Privacy notifications
settings.notify_attention.description: Notify only when a known active agent changes to waiting or blocked. Disabled by default.
settings.notify_attention.label: Notify on attention needed
settings.show_attention.description: Show the active, waiting, or blocked state beside each session in the panel.
settings.show_attention.label: Show attention state
settings.show_count.description: Show the ordinal number of the active agent currently displayed by this bar widget.
settings.show_count.label: Show displayed-agent number
settings.show_intent.description: Show the state inferred from active OMP agents' current tool intents in the bar.
settings.show_intent.label: Show intent state
settings.show_task.description: Show the current OMP todo item for each session in the panel.
settings.show_task.label: Show current task
ui.chat_empty: Send a message to this full coding session. Its harness-native tools, rules, skills, extensions, model, and history are active.
ui.chat_error: Coding session bridge returned an invalid response
ui.chat_picker_help: Continue a finished OMP session, safely fork one that is active elsewhere, or choose an installed harness and model for a new project session.
ui.chat_terminal_active: Terminal owns this session. Conversation refreshes here; exit the terminal before replying in this panel.
ui.health_not_ready: No supported coding-agent harness is available
